died.name: Stephen Crane
died.last_words: When you come to the hedge that we must all go over, it isn't so bad. You feel sleepy, you don't care. Just a little dreamy anxiety, which world you're really in, that's all.

died.name: O. Henry
died.last_words: Pull up the shades; I don't want to go home in the dark.
